name: B10-0572/2025 (The Left) – Grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the grave political situation in Guinea-Bissau after the coup of 26 November
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns the military takeover in Guinea-Bissau on 26 November, which stopped election results from being published after the 23 November vote. It asks for the democratic order to be restored immediately and for detained political figures, including Domingos Simões Pereira, to be released. It also calls on the European Commission to review its policies and make sure cooperation funds do not strengthen military or authoritarian structures. This is a statement of position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament condemns the coup and demands the elected government be restored.
- It calls for the release of detained opposition figures and an end to political persecution.
- It asks the European Commission to review how its funds are used in Guinea-Bissau.
